mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance_contract ( insurer_id, product_offering_id, contract_no, contract_date, agent_id, organization_id, premium_per_cycle_amount, first_premium_amount, monthly_equivalent_first_premium, premium_conversion_rule_code, payment_cycle_code, payment_term_months, standard_surrender_deduction_amount, current_status, data_origin ) VALUES ( #{insurerId}, #{productOfferingId}, #{contractNo}, #{contractDate}, #{agentId}, #{organizationId}, #{premiumPerCycleAmount}, #{firstPremiumAmount}, #{monthlyEquivalentFirstPremium}, #{premiumConversionRuleCode}, #{paymentCycleCode}, #{paymentTermMonths}, #{standardSurrenderDeductionAmount}, #{currentStatus}, #{dataOrigin} )
mapper.select: SELECT contract_id, insurer_id, product_offering_id, contract_no, contract_date, agent_id, organization_id, premium_per_cycle_amount, first_premium_amount, monthly_equivalent_first_premium, premium_conversion_rule_code, payment_cycle_code, payment_term_months, standard_surrender_deduction_amount, current_status, data_origin FROM insurance_contract WHERE contract_id = #{id}

SELECT ic.contract_no, p.product_name, ic.contract_date, ic.premium_per_cycle_amount, ic.payment_cycle_code, ic.first_premium_amount, ic.monthly_equivalent_first_premium, ic.payment_term_months, ic.standard_surrender_deduction_amount, ic.current_status AS contract_status, ic.data_origin FROM insurance_contract ic JOIN product_offering po ON ic.product_offering_id = po.product_offering_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE ic.contract_id = #{contractId}
mapper.update: UPDATE insurance_contract SET insurer_id = #{insurerId}, product_offering_id = #{productOfferingId}, contract_date = #{contractDate}, agent_id = #{agentId}, organization_id = #{organizationId}, premium_per_cycle_amount = #{premiumPerCycleAmount}, first_premium_amount = #{firstPremiumAmount}, monthly_equivalent_first_premium = #{monthlyEquivalentFirstPremium}, premium_conversion_rule_code = #{premiumConversionRuleCode}, payment_cycle_code = #{paymentCycleCode}, payment_term_months = #{paymentTermMonths}, standard_surrender_deduction_amount = #{standardSurrenderDeductionAmount}, current_status = #{currentStatus}, data_origin = #{dataOrigin} WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
